lia.f: Heads-up: We're launching an A/B pricing matrix experiment next week (A = flat-per-embed, B = tiered-volume discounts) targeted at EU early-adopters. Need ops + currency/FX checks before go.

derek.m: Important: EU contracts are billed in EUR. The experiment will change per-unit cents so FX rounding could create invoice noise. We should simulate invoicing in EUR using yesterday's FX rate and worst-case +/-1% swing.

lia.f: Good call. Evan, can you run a synthetic invoice run for both price variants and show line-item diffs for top 50 EU customers? Need to check negative line-item flips.

evan.s: Will do. Quick plan: 1) join usage -> price_variant -> currency_rate 2) render proforma invoice lines 3) compare net_due per customer. SQL Ill start with: 

```
WITH priced AS (
  SELECT u.customer_id, u.usage_tokens, p.variant, p.price_per_token, r.rate_to_eur
  FROM billing.usage u
  JOIN experiments.pricing_map p ON u.customer_tag = p.cohort
  JOIN fx.rates r ON r.date = u.usage_date
  WHERE p.experiment_id = 'exp_ab_matrix_2026' AND u.region = 'EU'
)
SELECT customer_id, variant, SUM(usage_tokens*price_per_token*rate_to_eur) AS est_eur
FROM priced
GROUP BY customer_id, variant
ORDER BY est_eur DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

evan.s: I'll post CSV by EOD. Also flagging: our billing exporter truncates to 2 decimals in cents; rounding may flip taxes.

tia.b: Sales: please add a refundable credit rule for any customer hit by >5% net increase; we want to avoid churn. Approval needed from VP Finance for credits > 10k EUR.

derek.m: Ops change: we'll add invoice.metadata.pricing_experiment and invoice.metadata.variant and invoice.metadata.fx_rate_date. Minimal schema bump. Rollback is removing variant flag and re-exporting previous price map.

billing-bot: [automated] Experiment created: exp_ab_matrix_2026 | variants=[A,B] | start=2026-07-06 | cohort=EU_early | id=exp_ab_matrix_2026

lia.f: Success criteria: no more than 3 customers with >10% net change OR no single customer >25k EUR delta. If exceeded, pause and trigger manual review.

evan.s: Running a sensitivity test with FX +/-1.5% and tier boundary noise. Also checking VAT implications (some customers are VAT-exempt).

tia.b: Can sales get a pre-approved exemptions list? We'll accept sales-submitted cases flagged "ab-matrix-exempt" in SFDC; finance will auto-approve if ARR < 10k EUR. Anything > that needs VP sign-off.

derek.m: Monitoring: add dashboard for daily variant throughput, percent_delta_by_customer, and exported_invoices_with_experiment_tag. Alert if daily percent_delta median > 2%.

lia.f: Timeline: simulation results from Evan by 6pm today, schema change deploy window tomorrow 4am PT (quick DB migration), canary export Friday 09:00 PT for 10 customers, full cohort Monday 08:00 PT.

evan.s: CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-finance/tmp/ab_matrix_simulation_1768123456.csv. Top anomaly customers: cust_103, cust_77. I'll DM details.

billing-bot: [automated] Experiment status: exp_ab_matrix_2026 -> scheduled for 1768473600 (2026-07-15 08:00:00 PT)

lia.f: Thanks team. If anyone sees issues in the sim CSV please shout here. Otherwise we proceed with the DB flag and canary next week. :rocket:
